name: Abnormal Interfacing (Akashic)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Ability to shape at least one 1 veil.

Benefit(s): Choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. You may use the chosen ability score in place of one of the other ability scores for the purpose of veilweaving.

You gain 1 point of essence.

Special: You may select this feat multiple times. Each time beyond the first, select a class which grants the ability to shape one or more veils as a class feature. You may use the chosen ability score in place of one of the other ability scores for the purpose of any class features from the class. Each additional instance of this feat also grants 1 point of essence.
